content_boundaries: Threat remains suspenseful rather than sadistic
sensitivity_requirements: Fear responses should not be mocked

scene_state.purpose: Create a locked location reference for the page-001 rural train platform.

composition.sheet_layout: Large spatial overview with three perspective views and focused landmark details.
views: detail view of hanging bell and timetable board
composition.spatial_map: Show the roof posts, track edge, tunnel mouth, bell, timetable board, and both platform exits in one consistent plan.
composition.scale_cues: Include unlabeled human-height silhouettes and standard door and bench proportions.

manga_style.linework: clear architectural ink lines, wet surfaces shown with screen tones
manga_style.line_weight_strategy: Heavy structural foregrounds, medium landmarks, and fine receding architecture.
manga_style.solid_black_strategy: Reserve dense black for the tunnel, roof cavities, and night beyond the platform.
manga_style.screen_tones: Wet floor reflections, rain, and lamp falloff use separable restrained tones.
manga_style.contrast_plan: Landmarks stay identifiable in both the overview and small detail views.
manga_style.depth_plan: Consistent perspective grids connect all views and preserve platform geography.
manga_style.motion_language: Only rain and reflected ripples imply movement; architecture remains stable.

blocking_reasons: Image generation is disabled for the pilot fixture.
